n0:createOracleTrigger.n0:source:
CREATE OR REPLACE EDITIONABLE TRIGGER "%USER_NAME%"."NOTES_AFU" AFTER UPDATE ON PEDS_MSTR.NOTES REFERENCING NEW AS New OLD AS Old FOR EACH ROW DECLARE vNum NUMBER; BEGIN IF :old.objective != :new.objective THEN UPDATE objectives SET objective = :new.objective WHERE o_id = :new.o_id; END IF; END;
/
